Question: The expression \(\dfrac{2x^2-x}{(x+1)(x-2)}\) \({}-\dfrac{4+x}{(x+1)(x-2)}\) cannot be evaluated for \(x=-1\) or \(x=2,\) since division by zero is not allowed. For other values of \(x:\)

Choices.A: The expression takes on many different values.
Choices.B: The expression has only the value \(2.\)
Choices.C: The expression has only the value \(1.\)
Choices.D:
The expression always has a value between \(-1\) and
\(2.\)
Choices.E:
The expression has a value greater than \(2\) or less than
\(-1.\)
